paragraphs.text: The Surgeon Commander is a legendary Wombat Bat Chameleon hybrid humanoid from Bablovia .

The Surgeon Commander is a hybrid bipedal being comprised of the hindparts of a wombat, bat wings, and a chameleon's arms and tail. It is unclear what the "base" being the Surgeon was before his augmentation. He is a member of Crossbreed Labs . He wears a white lab coat and appears to be teaching a class, and he likes augmentation, fluffy animals, and creative templating. He was previously known as or served as a Surgeon General.
